user_holds_shares.meaning: user holds gHYBR shares obtained by depositing HYBR, locked in the shared veNFT

withdraw_completed.meaning: the full-exit GovernanceHYBR.withdraw call completes successfully and the user receives their locked HYBR instead of reverting

claims.scope: GovernanceHYBR.withdraw full exit forwarding split amounts to VotingEscrow.multiSplit

preconditions.text: User holds gHYBR shares obtained by depositing HYBR via GovernanceHYBR.deposit, with funds locked in the shared veNFT.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A user withdrawing their entire position should be able to exit and receive their locked HYBR rather than have the withdrawal revert.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The multiSplit revert propagates and the withdrawal fails.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The withdrawing user is the position holder calling GovernanceHYBR.withdraw with all their shares.
The withdrawal path forwards split amounts to VotingEscrow.multiSplit.

limitations: Only the withdraw_reverts impact is formalized; the self-DoS exit-failure impact is handled in a separate pass.
The zero split element root cause is not encoded as a precondition; it belongs to the failure mechanism.
